status: NOT EXECUTED. Nothing in this manifest has been deployed, funded, signed for mainnet or submitted.
purpose: The concrete, reviewable description of the ONE public execution Held would perform if L10 opened. It is written before the fact, so that the execution can be checked against a prior commitment rather than described afterwards.

blocking_gate.authorization_note: Executing this manifest would deploy a contract and spend funds on a public chain. That is NOT authorized by the current instructions and must be requested explicitly before any step below is taken.

target.chain_id_field_caveat: KeeperHub's catalog exposes an internal string id per chain (Base = '9wr4m6zv2dwflb1trbzsx') alongside the numeric chainId. Held sends chainId. Which the authenticated contract-call route expects is NOT established, because that route requires the credential. If it wants the internal id, the field to change is ContractCallRequest.to_payload in adapter/held_adapter/execution/keeperhub.py.

prerequisites_in_order.note: Requires explicit authorization. No contract has been deployed to any public chain.
prerequisites_in_order.constructor_inputs: safe, roles, morpho, token, marketId, lineage, Keys{normalRole, restorationRole, supplyAmount, normalWithdrawAmount, restorationAmount, normalCount, restorationCount}
prerequisites_in_order.invariant: The controller is paused at construction (active=false) and has two typed entry points. It cannot execute anything before step 4.

prerequisites_in_order.action: Deploy or identify the customer Safe (2-of-3) and its Zodiac Roles module.
prerequisites_in_order.status: NOT DONE on mainnet. A genuine 2-of-3 Safe 1.4.1 + Zodiac Roles v2.1 fixture is exercised on the Base-mainnet fork.

prerequisites_in_order.action: Owner ceremony: scope the roles, bind the non-refilling allowances, enable the controller as a role member.
prerequisites_in_order.constraint: Allowances must be non-refilling. The controller refuses a refilling allowance both at activation and during operation (AllowanceRefillsNotPermitted).

prerequisites_in_order.action: Activate the controller with an explicit ExpectedState.
prerequisites_in_order.constraint: Activation refuses stale expected state and refuses a ceiling below existing consumption.

prerequisites_in_order.status: NOT DONE. No funds have been moved on any public chain.

prerequisites_in_order.note: This is the first step that produces genuine L10 evidence.

the_execution.description: A single SUPPLY of USDC into the pinned Morpho market, decided by the native Almanak strategy, intercepted by Held, authorized by the runner and submitted through KeeperHub.

outer_call.function: executeSupply(Envelope env, MarketParams mp, uint256 amount, bytes signature)
outer_call.value: 0 (the entry points are non-payable; the client refuses a non-zero value)
outer_call.idempotency: idempotencyKey = keccak("held.keeperhub.execution-key.v1" || operationId || attemptId). A retry of the same attempt reuses it; a replacement attempt gets a new one.

inner_calls_through_roles: USDC.approve(Morpho, amount)  -- bounded, then reset to 0 in the same transaction
Morpho.supply(marketParams, amount, 0, safe, 0x)  -- fixed-asset, empty callback, onBehalf = the customer Safe
what_the_controller_checks_before_it_ret: Exact Safe debit equals the amount.

Exact share accounting: the (assets, shares) Morpho reports must equal the observed position change. Supply rounds shares DOWN after interest accrual; the controller compares for equality, not direction, and uses no tolerance.
Borrow shares still zero, collateral unchanged.
Managed allowance zero on both sides of the call.
The native Roles quota and the shared normal count were each charged exactly once.
consumed[operationId] = payloadHash, written in the SAME transaction as the economic effect.

limits_in_force.note: Concrete values are set by the customer at activation. The manifest fixes the DIMENSIONS, so no limit can be silently absent.
limits_in_force.enforced_twice: Held's own typed limits AND the native Zodiac Roles conditions. Roles independently refuses bad arguments from a role member, bounds the approval, and requires an empty SUPPLY callback -- proven on the fork against real Roles v2.1, including the specific condition-violation selector 0xd0a9bf58.

funds_at_risk.statement: Whatever USDC the customer funds the Safe with, bounded by the limits above. Held never takes custody: the Safe owns the position, onBehalf is the Safe, and a withdraw can only pay the Safe.
controller_cannot: move funds to any address other than the Safe
execute any call other than the two typed entry points
exceed a native Roles allowance, or refill one
execute a second time under the same operation id

what_would_be_published.transaction_link: One Basescan link to the executed controller call.
what_would_be_published.not_included: No credentials, no private keys, no private RPC URLs. The repository is private and nothing here authorizes making it public or publishing a release.

honest_boundaries: This manifest is a COMMITMENT, not evidence. It records what would happen; it does not show that it did.
Everything proven so far is proven on a Base-mainnet FORK at block 51353212, plus local tests. A fork is real pinned code but it is not a public transaction.
The hosted KeeperHub route has never been exercised. L10 is BLOCKED-UNKNOWN and is neither stubbed nor simulated anywhere in this repository.
Independent acceptance of every phase remains pending. accepted=false.
